records.source: AND THEN IT CATCHES UP. The wheel for a release cannot contain its own release note -- the note is written when the GitHub release is published, which is after that wheel is on PyPI -- so a bundled file is always one release behind the build carrying it, and that is what went wrong: "im on 1.5.1.0 and the news only goes to 1.5.0.7. the news section should always automatically reflect the latest spacr release news." Nothing here opens a socket: the panel only asks, and a fetch that fails, is rate-limited, is switched off in Preferences, or simply finds nothing newer leaves the bundled list exactly as it was drawn.

records.source: **Plaque mode** -- a folder of cropped plaque images. The run segments every image and writes one table of per-image values and one of per-plaque values. records.context: **Plaque mode** -- a folder of cropped plaque images. The processing session segments every image and writes one table of per-image values and one of per-plaque values. All there is to check before executing is the mask, so the preview segments one image with the model and thresholds the processing session will use and draws the plaque outlines, with the count and mean area.
records.translation: **Plaque-hamur** -- mappa með skornum skellumyndum. Keyrslan hlutar hverja mynd og skrifar eina töflu með gildum fyrir hverja mynd og aðra með gildum fyrir hverja skellu. Það eina sem þarf að athuga áður en keyrt er er gríman, svo forsýnin hlutar eina mynd með líkaninu og þröskuldunum sem keyrslan mun nota og teiknar útlínur skellnanna, ásamt fjölda og meðalflatarmáli.
records.review_basis: written from the English (no current MT draft)

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.plaque_preview#3
records.source: **Figure mode** -- a folder of published figures. The run finds the plaque images inside each figure with a detector, reads the text printed around them, decides which condition each one shows, and segments each crop. The preview does every one of those steps on one figure and shows them: the boxes, the text that was read, the proposed condition per image, and the plaque outlines inside each box. The table under it is where a person corrects a condition and ticks it OK; saving writes ``figure_annotations.csv`` beside the figures, which the run reads.
records.context: **Figure mode** -- a folder of published figures. The processing session finds the plaque images inside each figure with a detector, reads the text printed around them, decides which condition each one shows, and segments each extracted image region. The preview does every one of those steps on one figure and shows them: the boxes, the text that was read, the proposed condition per image, and the plaque outlines inside each box. The table under it is where a person corrects a condition and ticks it OK; saving writes ``figure_annotations.csv`` beside the figures, which the processing session reads.
records.translation: **Figure-hamur** -- mappa með birtum myndum. Keyrslan finnur skellumyndirnar inni í hverri mynd með skynjara, les textann sem prentaður er í kringum þær, ákveður hvaða aðstæður hver þeirra sýnir, og hlutar hvern myndskurð. Forsýnin gerir hvert þessara skrefa á einni mynd og sýnir þau: kassana, textann sem var lesinn, tillögu að aðstæðum fyrir hverja mynd, og útlínur skellnanna inni í hverjum kassa. Taflan fyrir neðan er þar sem manneskja leiðréttir aðstæður og hakar við OK; vistun skrifar ``figure_annotations.csv`` við hlið myndanna, sem keyrslan les.
